# Raghav Sharma

> Raghav Sharma is a product engineer who builds developer tools, AI products, and blockchain infrastructure with Rust and TypeScript.

Canonical portfolio: https://raghav.codes/

## Profile

- Founder and lead engineer of LearnSol, a hands-on Solana and Rust learning platform used by 2,200+ developers.
- Previous software engineering internships at FOSSEE, IIT Bombay and Debales AI.
- Solana Foundation grant recipient for LearnSol.
- First place at Smart India Hackathon in 2024.
- Member of Superteam India.
